boss_defeated: Guardian defeated — the stairs are unsealed
boss_floor: Floor %1 — defeat the Guardian to unseal the stairs
chest_locked: Locked chest — you need a key
choose_delver_hint: Each class has different starting stats and an active skill. You can choose again on every new run.
class_arcanist_desc: Area specialist. Arc Nova damages every nearby enemy at once.
class_rogue_desc: Fast striker. Shadow Strike hits a nearby enemy hard and grants brief evasion.
class_sentinel_desc: High endurance. Shield Bash damages adjacent enemies and grants temporary guard.
desktop_controls: WASD / arrows move · H potion · B bomb · E shop · Esc settings
guide_boss: Every fifth floor has a Guardian. Defeat it before the stairs can be used.
guide_combat: Walk into enemies to attack. Potions heal; bombs damage nearby enemies.
guide_loot: Keys open chests. Relics improve the current run. Soul Shards survive death and buy permanent upgrades.
guide_move: Desktop: WASD/arrows. Mobile: swipe on the dungeon or use the large D-pad.
guide_skill: Use your class skill with F/Space on desktop or the highlighted skill button on mobile. Skills recharge as you take turns.
legacy_hint: Soul Shards survive run restarts and buy permanent upgrades.
level_up: Level up! Attack and HP increased
objective_first_floor: Explore · open a chest · collect a Soul Shard · find the stairs
objective_floor: Explore, gather loot, and reach the stairs
objective_guardian: Defeat the Guardian, then reach the stairs
run_warning: Starting a new run keeps Soul Shards and legacy upgrades, but resets the current dungeon run.
skill_guard_hit: Shield Bash strikes nearby enemies and raises your guard
title: Dungeon Delver
